members.note: Real warehouse НеИспользовать write via the Записать command button. Proof chain: (1) DB-confirmed mutation+recovery (Нет→Да→Нет); (2) action-write frames isolated; (3) two reference captures fully_stable (byte-identical normalized hash); (4) a Python-manager-driven probe replayed the full 861-frame flow against a live TestClient with zero divergence (all 861 frames answered) and its action-write phase normalized hash matches the Vanessa reference (python_manager_acceptance.json, verdict=accepted). The Python manager reproduced the write exchange without the Vanessa manager.
